callbackUrls.intro: Copy the addresses below and paste them into the PayNow merchant panel (Settings → Shops and payment points → shop configuration). They are built from a sales channel domain, including its path, e.g. /en.
callbackUrls.notificationHelp: Webhook that PayNow calls with payment statuses. Required for orders to be marked as paid automatically. Any shop domain works (including a /pl or /en prefix), but not the bare host when every domain has a prefix. Use the same address in the production and the sandbox panel.
callbackUrls.returnHelp: Fallback only — with every payment the plugin sends its own return address on the domain the customer ordered from.
callbackUrls.copyError: Copy failed — please copy the address manually
callbackUrls.domainLoadError: Could not read the sales channel domains, so the addresses cannot be shown. Enter your shop domain including its path in the PayNow panel (e.g. https://your-shop.com/en/payment/notification) or reload the page.
